reuse.why: expectedAmount comes from the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already implements the missing -> 0, number -> itself, range -> furthest-from-zero rule.

duplication.why: The diff writes no amount logic of its own; it is one call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is mapped in scheduleModel.toExternal in server/api-models.ts and the list handler's return type is updated in types/api-handlers.ts, where API shapes live.

scope.why: A list-entity type, one mapped field, the handler's return type and a focused test; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Rule changes in getScheduledAmount reach the API automatically, and the separate APIScheduleListEntity keeps the read-only field out of the create/update input type.
